title: a little here or there ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
author: AaronH
rules:
it's probably a little here or there to you, but i've put a little in the bank.

congratulations to evan on the first month of sudokubank.

rules

• 6x6 sudoku: fill the grid with digits 1-6 so that no digit repeats in any row, column or box.

there is a negative constraint in this puzzle.
• on the index line, no digit may index itself.

• index lines: along a cyan line beginning at the square tip, the position of each digit determines another digit’s location. a digit x in position y requires a digit y in position x.

• black dots: a black dot connects two digits where one is exactly double the other. not all dots are necessarily given.
